The '''2008–09 Czech First League''', known as the [[Gambrinus (beer)|Gambrinus]] liga for sponsorship reasons, was the sixteenth season of [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier of [[association football|football]]. It began on 2 August 2008 and ended on 30 May 2009. [[SK Slavia Prague|Slavia Prague]] were the defending champions. Slavia secured their 17th title overall after a 3–1 win away against [[FK Viktoria Žižkov|Viktoria Žižkov]] in 28th round. They were the first club to defend Czech title since the [[2000–01 Czech First League|2000–01 season]].

==Promotion and relegation==
[[FK Baník Most|Most]] and [[Bohemians 1905]] were relegated to the [[2008–09 Czech 2. Liga|second division]] after finishing last and second to last, respectively, in the [[2007–08 Czech First League|previous season]].

[[FK Bohemians Prague (Střížkov)]] (as champions) and [[1. FK Příbram]] (as runners-up) were promoted from the [[2007–08 Czech 2. Liga|second division]].
